reason: I already check the placement cell, LinkedIn, Internshala, and Unstop, so I don't see enough reason to add another place to search. Having to set up hosting and provider keys makes it feel like extra work when I'm already busy preparing for placements.
objection: I don't know whether it would actually find useful postings I can't already see, and I'm not confident I can configure the server and keys without help.
would_change_my_mind: A quick demo showing relevant, fresh listings I couldn't find on my usual sites, with setup handled for me.
